subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a public configurable TUI submit/newline keybinding surface beyond the existing Shift+Enter and Ctrl+J defaults?
rationale: The central newline capability is already implemented by the pinned editor, while configuration would create a new user-facing compatibility contract that repository policy says should have a high bar.

options.title: Document current bindings
options.body: Complete `/help` and public docs for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and terminal fallback behavior without adding configuration.

options.title: Add configurable bindings
options.body: Define a narrow TUI preference with Enter-to-send preserved by default plus conflict, fresh-install, and upgrade coverage.

recommendation.title: Document current bindings
recommendation.body: Complete `/help` and public docs for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and terminal fallback behavior without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and prior issue review connect him most directly to the TUI editor, shortcut docs, and remaining product-surface decision.
